I was told that sudden swelling and a rash in my lower limbs was 'just something that happens to women'. I also have "pupils dilated ++" written in my notes even though it's a side effect of my prescribed medication and I have no record whatsoever of displaying drug seeking behaviour.

The receptionists were so supportive and helpful, but the actual Dr was one of the worst human beings I've had the misfortune to meet. He was rude, dismissive, insulting and aggressive. After he dismissed my symptoms as drug seeking behaviour I went to A&E and I was having a reaction to my medication that was impacting my heart and if I'd not stopped taking one of my meds it could have been lethal. He later wrote in my medical notes that I went to the hospital for no reason.

He also held my main prescription hostage and heavily implied that if I complained I wouldn't get the meds that I need. (If I don't then I have to go to hospital).
